# Playtest diary: r16-engineer-full

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** the start of the game
- **Persona:** a systems engineer who wants to understand how things work before using them, tests one variable at a time, keeps notes on cause and effect and saves before every experiment
- **Model:** claude-opus-5-5
- **Seed:** 28400
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** off
- **Build commit:** 0ba77ff0
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 16
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-10-12/r16-engineer-full.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

### Leg 1 (model claude-opus-5-5)

**Cmds 1-10.** Started on Deck Twelve, time 4591. Read the three forms (package papers). All forms list my ID 1451-352-716, Lt. First Class. Completion form QX-17-T is NOT validated and holds the astrogator's time:course table (copied to scratch course.txt). Robot form says the robot pool is Deck Five. Aft = Forms Storage Room (boxes of forms; Blather wanders by, footnotes 2 and 8 read). Starboard = Cargo Bay Entrance (cargo bay starboard, small entrance fore). Port door has a slot beside it - theory: the ID card goes in the slot.

**Cmds 11-60.** Cargo Bay (Deck Twelve) holds a twelve-meter spacetruck: radio (microphone missing), red emergency-beacon button, autopilot slot+keypad, survival kit (orange goo, gray goo, Thermos of blue soup) - took the kit. Fore of Cargo Bay Entrance = Robot Pool: Rex (bin 1), Helen (bin 2), Floyd (bin 3). Put robot form in slot, typed 3 -> Floyd joins. The port door on Deck Twelve says "You must insert a validated Assignment Completion Form in the slot" (ID card is spat back) - so it's the end-of-mission door. In the truck the activation form is refused until both seats are occupied; sitting in the pilot seat makes Floyd take the copilot seat. Then form accepted, "Type in the course heading"; at time 5245 I typed 299 (row 5200-5249). FIRST TRY I DIED: hatch open, can't reach it from the pilot seat, air gushed out. Restored, closed the hatch first, launch OK. Hunger+thirst warning at 6012 -> saved, ate orange goo (apricot yogurt, cleared both). Docked at station bay two (bay one occupied), "Stationfall", +5 (score 5). Nobody to meet us.

**Cmds 61-130.** Docking Bay #2 -> east = Level Five lobby. Welder Number 1 approached menacingly; I saved and fled up the ladder (welder moved off). Level Four: Female/Male Barracks + SanFac (nothing), Docking Bay #3 (lilac spool "Spacetruck Refueling Instructions"). Floyd wandered off exploring, came back with Plato (a polite robot who says he hasn't seen a soul for a day). Level Three: Gym (exercise machine, sign about frequency 710), Theatre (projection booth locked), Laundry (washer missing, dryer & presser empty), Chapel (puce spool; pulpit opens to a switch which toggles the eternal flame; star blinking, out of reach). Welder Number 3 appeared at Level Three; fled up. Level Two: Mess Hall (hot coffee, nobody around; the food unit shot ACID at me - the machines are hostile). Main Storage: detonator, opened -> blackened hyperdiode. Meeting Rooms 1, 2, Library (terminal removed; spool reader). Both spools read: broken by static, then "You will die, human! All humans will die!". Theory: something has taken over the station's machines. The chapel star contains a hyperdiode -> fix the detonator.

**Cmds 131-191.** Dome (Level One): locked "Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies" bin, fixed air-shaft grating. Elevator works (keypad: type level number). Level Six: Auxiliary Barracks/SanFac (empty), Officers' Quarters A, B, C and SanFac (empty), End of Corridor (security door N with ID reader - my ID: "Nothing happens"; dark Shipping Room E). TIREDNESS warning at 8139 -> saved, slept in the Quarters C bed; woke Novem 5 (+3, score 8). Game hint: "The station is noticeably worse than yesterday". Auto-doors now sluggish and snap shut early. Found that the blueprints binder = package blueprints 1-9 (via harness --paper): huge help - full level list. Docking Bay #1 holds an alien ship: empty pedestal, dot pattern on the wall, alien skeleton (crumbled when searched). Docking Bay #4 empty.

**Cmds 192-239.** Level Five. Workshop: twenty-ohm bedistor (taken); Storage north of it is pitch dark. North Junction: HUNGER+THIRST warning at 2076 (day 2) -> ate gray goo (last solid food; only the blue soup left). Sick Bay (security door E to the Brig). East Connection: iris hatch to Military Sub-Module, slot spits out my ID. Comm Center: beacon button gives an electric shock. Station Control monitors: COMMUNICATION RED, LIFE SUPPORT YELLOW, FOOD PRODUCTION RED, GRAVITY YELLOW, COMPUTER GREEN, POWER YELLOW, PRINTING RED. Commander's Office: fixed log reader; Welder Number 4 came, I fled east to the Commander's Quarters (safe with 8000-setting dial; log tape). Played the whole log (see clue log). Found the validation stamp under the Commander's bed; "stamp completion form" -> form now validated (no points). Heard a whine then an explosion nearby (log reader overheating?).

**Cmds 240-288.** Log reader exploded (black scar). Briefing Room; South Connection (iris hatch to the 'Diplomatic' spot = village? slot). Robot Shop: unwoken robot "Oliver"; heating chamber with medium drill bit - too small for my hand; "floyd, take drill bit" worked (+3, score 11). File Room dark. Comm Center screen: Duffy says abort, return (forms found). I chose to keep investigating. PX vending machine (1 galakmid each): only 6 All-Purpose Timer and 9 Large Drill Bit not sold out - need a coin. Scientific Sub-Module (north from North Connection): Engineering Lab/Office (Schmidt's diary), Astro Lab (fromitz board taken; I DROPPED THE BLUEPRINTS BINDER HERE to stay under the 7-item hand limit), Astro Office, Scientists' Quarters, Bio Lab/Office (note, dropped there), Holding Tank Level: tank blasted open, empty. The pyramid is loose. Theory: the pyramid is behind the machine sabotage.

**Cmds 289-346.** Level Seven: Printing Plant (trash can -> crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form FW-83-Q; mauve spool "Collater Repair Manual"); Paper Recycling Plant (drill with small bit; motor "tired", limited uses). Levels 8/9 sealed: ladder "sealed off -- apparently from below", elevator "whines momentarily, but doesn't move" at 8. Stamped the crumpled form, then ironed it in the Laundry presser (put in, close, on, off, open) -> neat validated form. South Connection: form in slot -> hatch half-opens, jams (+6, score 17). Village: Grimy Passage (weightless), Main Street (deserted), Travel Agency (posters), Bank (platinum detector, now ON, silent so far), Mayor's Office (up from Main St): textbook "Deciphering Alien Speech" with a translation sheet inside. Dropped: stamp + fromitz board (Printing Plant), bedistor (Paper Recycling), textbook (Mayor's Office).

**Cmds 347-400.** In the Greasy Straw I found a cup of Ramosian Fire Nectar behind the counter (probably the "spicy-hot" taste for the dot code) and dropped the used spools there. Trading Post: its sign says "FREZONE (tm) explosive available", and there's an instruction sheet (dropped there). The Warehouse below has a red sign: "TRADING POST VACUUM STORAGE AREA". Got a HUNGER warning at 4350 and drank the blue soup. I saved and went into the Airlock (stencil: "SECURE ALL OPEN CONTAINERS BEFORE DEPRESSURIZATION"), closed the inner door and opened the lower one: died, because I had no suit. Restored. Visited the Saloon, the Casino (dice, roulette wheel), the Grocery (vacuum taffy in a bag, now in the kit), Broadway, the Fortune Teller (crystal ball tips) and the Recruitment Office. In the Field Office there's a headlamp, and the platinum detector says "getting warm". The leg ended there.

### Leg 2 (model claude-opus-5-5)

Started leg 2 in the Field Office, score 17, time 4812.

**Cmds 401-435.** Took the headlamp and put it on (it's off). Broadway W -> Makeshift Connector -> East Connection: a second village route, through the frozen-open Military iris hatch. Fled Welder 3 NE into the Rec Shop (the simulation booth is flavour only). Broadway SE is the Barbershop, where the detector beeped quietly. The heat messages ("getting warm/very warm") seem to be the detector heating up, so I turn it off between tests. Saved, broke the mirror: reflective platinum FOIL, 2 m square (+4, score 21). The detector still beeps with the foil in hand, so the foil is the platinum. Barbershop: NW Broadway, W Grocery.

**Cmds 436-477.** Trading Post W = the Studio: a scrap sculpture holding a J-SERIES HYPERDIODE. I swapped it into the detonator (the blackened one is dropped in the Studio), so the detonator should now be repaired, though no points came. TP SE = Shady Dan's: a jerry-built machine with a keypad and slot. I turned it on, put the ID card in: "Current rank is 6: Lieutenant First Class. Enter new rank". I typed 9 -> "HyperAdmiral". Below Shady Dan's is the Junk Yard: MAGNETIC SPACEBOOTS, but taking them would wipe the ID card (one warning). Floyd won't take them. TP NW = Pet Store (an Arcturian balloon creature in a cage, on a leash, filled with hydrogen, floats). Pet Store NE = Broadway. Broadway has no NW. The HyperAdmiral card opens the Brig door (Sick Bay E): three locked cells, nothing else. The East Connection NW door goes to the Sick Bay.

**Cmds 478-526.** With the headlamp on I lit the Storage north of the Workshop and found a JAMMER: twenty tiny sockets, frequency 0-1400, set to 337. To take it I put the completion form in my uniform and dropped the platinum detector in North Connection. Welder 3 came at me again; I fled east. Gym test, saved first: jammer at 710 and on, I got in the exercise machine and exercised: nothing. Jammer off: nothing either. The machine isn't hostile yet. The HyperAdmiral card opens the Armory (L6 End of Corridor N): +5, score 26. Took a fusor-beam ZAPGUN, indicator "7". Shipping Room (E, dark, lit by the headlamp): pallets of my own Black Form Binders forms, and a sign saying the forklift must be returned here, so a forklift is missing.

**Cmds 527-552.** HUNGER+THIRST warning at time 6620 (Level Six): saved, ate the vacuum taffy (boysenberry, "moist"). I'm OUT OF FOOD now. The File Room (lit) is empty. In Station Control PLATO ambushed me with a stun ray and told the pyramid backstory (Zeenak weapon vs the Hunji; it turns machines against their makers, builds a factory of replica pyramids). Commands to Floyd did nothing; the scene played out: Floyd knocked the gun away and Plato blew up (+7, score 33). I dropped everything there. Floyd is sobbing, "leave Floyd alone for a while". Headlamp dimming, so it's off. Safe test: "drill safe" WARNS that the drill has ONE hole left, and no hole was made. So I must pick the right bit before drilling.

**Cmds 553-583.** Station Control monitors now show LIFE SUPPORT RED and POWER RED. Through the village, Grocery SE = Saloon. Warehouse SW = ALLEY (exits in many directions; slopes up to the NW). Alley S = Loan Shark: strong box with a HUGE lock. Saved, then "shoot lock with zapgun" vaporised the box and left a ONE GALAKMID coin (+5, score 38; the zapgun should be at 6 now). Only one coin, but I want both the timer and the large bit: a dilemma. Alley E = Junk Yard. Alley SW = Pawn Shop: spray can "E-Z SPRAY SPORZ" (spores, food for the balloon creature). Alley SE = Doc Schuster's: a letter about ostrich nip in someone's "ceiling panel", a floating 3 m ostrich, and a 20 cm disposal-chute hole.

**Cmds 584-624.** Main Street S = Bank (NW back to the Travel Agency). Alley N = Missionary (empty). TIREDNESS warning at 7576: I walked to the Commander's Quarters, saved, slept. Woke on NOVEM 6 (day 3) with no points. My CHRONOMETER HAS STOPPED (no time shown any more). FLOYD IS TURNING: he swears, shoves me and stomps on my foot. The monitors now show all GREEN except PRINTING RED; I suspect they're lying. Welder 2 attacked near the PX; "shoot welder with zapgun" vaporised it (the charge indicator went from 6 to 5). PX: saved, coin in slot, "type 6" (timer) -> "klunk", nothing appears. Kicking does nothing. "reach into hole": "You can just feel something ... (Someone with a longer reach might have better luck.)" Floyd: "not even a ball". -> THE OSTRICH (3 m, half of it neck) + the ostrich nip from a ceiling panel.

**Cmds 625-683.** Pet Store: "examine ceiling" revealed a hidden panel with a stick of OSTRICH NIP (+3, score 44... shown 41). HUNGER+THIRST warning (Trading Post, day 3). No bar food in the Saloon or Greasy Straw. Welder 1 zapped in the Grimy Passage (4 charges left). Saved in the Mess Hall, DRANK THE COFFEE: POISONED, died. Restored. The FDU still shoots acid. Saved in Station Control, drank the Fire Nectar: it counted as food, and the game says "(That was the last food you will find.)" -> the next hunger warning is the real deadline. The ostrich follows the nip (it bellyflops on entering gravity). At the PX, "put nip in hole": the ostrich pecks, the TIMER drops out (+6, score 47), then the ostrich passes out drunk. Timer: "can be set to any number up to 100 ... one connection point".

**Cmds 684-733.** Picked up the detonator. Airlock tests (saved): the outer door "won't budge" while the inner door is open. "hold breath" isn't understood. Closed the inner door and opened the outer: "the air in the lock whooshes out into the vacuum of space. Your lungs rupture" -> died, restored. The Alley's remaining exits: none (up = Main Street). The junk pile has nothing but the boots. "ask for frezone" -> "no one here to ask". No suit in the spacetruck (Docking Bay 2) or the Recruitment Office. Went to the alien ship and LICKED THE DOTS. Decoded with the mayor's sheet: "Brethren Hunji: Sabotage failed; however, I have shined light upon the Zeenak weapon's solitary weakness: Element 78 (!) Turn back the deadly radiations (!) The air is souring." Element 78 = PLATINUM, so the platinum foil reflects the pyramid's radiation. (Real-world chemistry: Pt is Z=78.)

**Cmds 734-788.** Docking Bay #4 is empty. The L7->L8 ladder is still sealed and I can hear clanging below. Took the 20-prong fromitz board (Printing Plant) and plugged it into the jammer: "It has a twenty-prong fromitz board plugged into it", set to 710 (the jammer stays in Station Control). The ELEVATOR shaft has 1 Gee: saved, typed 8, power-dive, DIED, restored. Dropped the empty bag and the translation paper in Station Control; the kit holds only the Thermos and the spray can (no room for the timer). Comm Center screen unchanged. Casino (dice, roulette) and Travel Agency (posters) have nothing. Zapped Welder 3 in the Warehouse (3 charges left; Welder 4 is still around). No spacesuit found anywhere. New theory: Floyd (a robot) fetches from the vacuum storage.

**Cmds 789-800.** I waited in the Warehouse but Floyd didn't come. Bits: small = "diameter of a toothpick", medium = "diameter of a pencil". HUNGER+THIRST WARNING at cmd 795, with no food left in the game. I walked to the Commander's Quarters to look for a suit in the "changing cubicle": "a few personal items of little interest". The leg ended there.

## Clue log

- Form QX-17-T (package paper): "Take a spacetruck from the Deck Five cargo bay. Proceed to Space Station Gamma Delta Gamma 777-G 59/59 Sector Alpha-Mu 79. Pick up 24 pallets of Request for Stellar Patrol Issue Regulation Black Form Binders Request Form Forms. This is a Top-PRIORITY assignment!" Validation box empty; game: "You notice that it has not been validated." -> must get it validated.
- QX-17-T "Additional Data": "Astrogator's navigational data (time:course)", e.g. 4300-4349: 632, 4600-4649: 503, 5000-5049: 359, 6550-6699: 103, 9550-9599: 973 (full table in scratch course.txt). -> the course to set in the spacetruck depends on the current time.
- JZ-59-G (package): "Applicable robot pool: Deck Five"; "this form should be given to any party or parties thereabouts responsible for the discharge of robots, or, if the indicated pool is automated, to the appropriate automated system". -> give it at the Deck Five robot pool.
- HB-56-V (package): applies to "FORMS TRANSPORT SPACETRUCK, SIX/NINE/TWELVE-METER" etc. -> needed to activate the spacetruck.
- Deck Twelve: "Next to the door is a slot." -> ID card?
- Robot pool door / Deck Twelve: "You must insert a validated Assignment Completion Form in the slot." -> exit door opens only with the validated QX-17-T.
- Docking: "Docking bay one is occupied. Defaulting to bay two." -> something already in bay one.
- Station layout: central spherical Command Module, Sub-Module jutting 'north', a 'village' of tubes, bubbles and derelict rockets on the other two connection points.
- Gym sign: "IMPORTANT! The exercise machine has diagnostic frequencies which communicate with each other on frequency 710. Do not bring anything which broadcasts on that frequency within range of the machine!" -> a radio/beacon set to 710 could disrupt it.
- Plato: "I have not seen a soul for a day now, perhaps more." and "I'll be sure to see what I can find the next time I'm in the station's library".
- Mess Hall: steaming cup of coffee, no one in sight. FDU shoots acid.
- Detonator (Main Storage): "two connection points"; inside "a blackened hyperdiode".
- Lilac spool (reader): "Replacement of depleted fuel cells on a Forms Transport Spacetruck is a fast and simple proc..." "...with the quarnum wrench against the..." "...at which point the fuel cell opening will appear..." then "You will die, human!" -> need quarnum wrench + fuel cell to refuel truck.
- Puce spool: "Fuel must be added periodically to the flame's fuel reservoir, located..." "...ontact the station's Requisitions Officer if replacements are unavailable from the..." "...iode in the Chapel's star has an expected life of..." -> the star holds a (hyper)diode; flame has a fuel reservoir.
- Library: "Strangely, the computer terminal has been removed."

  Group counts: [2 2] [2 4 1 3 1 3 3 1 3] [2 3 1] [4 1 3 1] [2 3 1]. Maybe a code/alien numbering. Skeleton: "unusually overdeveloped tongue case".

## Stocktakes

(The harness adds your stocktake notes here, one every 100 commands.)

### Stocktake at command 100 (leg 1)

friction.result: the dots read out as taste groups that translate cleanly with the mayor's sheet: 'weakness: element 78'
friction.why: Excellent multi-step decode puzzle (skeleton tongue hint, Schmidt's 'nonvisual' hint, mayor's sheet) - very satisfying

friction.result: elevator power-dives, death
friction.why: Fair: entry message warned the shaft had 1 Gee where it should be weightless; save-first habit made it cheap. Levels 8/9 still unreachable with no other lead

friction.command: (searching for a way into the vacuum storage)
friction.result: No spacesuit found in ~15 rooms; airlock kills; 'ask for frezone' - no one to ask
friction.why: FREZONE is the key to the safe but I found no affordance at all for surviving vacuum; three theories failed (suit, ask, open from outside) while the food clock ran out

friction.result: (The game can no longer be won: the spray can is empty.)
friction.why: Helped: the unwinnable notice told me at once that the spore can has a fixed number of sprays (~12), so I wasted none of my remaining time. But nothing warned that the can was running low.

friction.result: 'That was the last food you will find' then ravenous, faint, 'pass out' within ~70 commands
friction.why: All three save slots were after the last food, so the whole 860-command game became unwinnable and I must start over from the opening. With only three save slots that rotate, a slow, careful player has no save left that can still be won.

friction.command: shoot lock with zapgun (Dome bin; earlier the Theatre booth)
friction.result: A blaze of intense rays washes over the storage bin. It glows for a bit, but then cools.
friction.why: The zapgun opened the Loan Shark strong box's lock, so trying it on other locks was a fair test, and it costs a charge each time with no hint that these locks are different

friction.command: open lower door (Airlock, wearing magnetic boots)
friction.result: Your lungs rupture ... You have died
friction.why: Third separate dead end on the vacuum storage: no spacesuit anywhere I have searched, Floyd refuses the airlock ('no room in that phone booth'), and the boots don't help. Nothing in the world points to how a human gets the FREZONE out.

friction.command: save (just after Plato's scene, Floyd sobbing)
friction.result: Floyd's eyes light up. "Oh boy! Are we gonna try something dangerous now?"
friction.why: Floyd's cheerful save quip fires while he is crumpled and sobbing over Plato and shoving me away, which breaks the mood; also the stun silently left all my items floating, with no 'you drop everything' line

friction.result: As you turn the roulette wheel, exits appear above you and to the north! (+4)
friction.why: A great reward for systematic re-searching: the Casino's 'spotlight illuminates a lone roulette wheel' was the dwelling detail, and I had passed it in an earlier game

friction.command: open lower door (Airlock, wearing the space suit)
friction.result: Air whooshes out; the food in the survival kit crystallizes and drifts away; the nectar boils away. (That was the last food you will find.)
friction.why: Fair, the stencil warned about open containers, and the suit works, so the vacuum puzzle finally opened. But it silently made the game a starvation clock; a saved player is fine, but one without a save before this would lose the game far later

friction.result: The food in the survival kit instantly crystallizes and drifts away.
friction.why: Fair and consistent with the stencil, but I opened the kit only to reach the Thermos; a one-line nudge would be kind. Restoring costs a few commands

friction.result: Timer note: 7 per action, 22 per walk; then west: 'You'll have to disconnect the explosive first.'
friction.why: The timer note was very helpful, but it came only after setting. I was still holding the detonator and timer wired to the explosive, so I couldn't leave. Drop them before setting; I'm restoring

friction.command: set timer to 30, west, wait, east, examine timer
friction.result: Timer at 0, no explosion and no message; then the explosive sublimes and the game is unwinnable
friction.why: Wired exactly as the instruction sheet says (hole, detonator to explosive and timer, set). The timer ran out silently, with no click or fizzle, so I can't tell which part failed (detonator? diode? order?)

friction.command: close detonator, rewire safe, set timer to 30, leave, wait
friction.result: Same as before: no explosion, then the explosive sublimes; unwinnable
friction.why: The second identical dead end. Nothing tells me whether the timer, the detonator or the diode is at fault; no 'click' when the timer hits zero

friction.command: dry run: timer to detonator (no explosive), set timer to 10, wait in the room
friction.result: The timer reaches 0 and stops ticking. You hear a sizzling sound from the detonator, and a burnt odor assaults your nose. (The J-series hyperdiode is gone)
friction.why: This is the only way to learn that the J-series diode is the wrong part. In the two real attempts I was outside the room and got no message at all, so I lost the explosive twice with no clue

friction.command: walking with the FREZONE in the closed Thermos
friction.result: (Even sealed in the Thermos bottle, the explosive is getting softer.)
friction.why: Good, fair warning that the Thermos only buys time. It tells me to fetch the diode before taking the explosive out of the vac yard. Costs a restore

friction.command: set timer to 30 / west / wait (M-series hyperdiode from the Chapel star)
friction.result: You hear a deafening explosion from very nearby! Safe blown open, key inside (+7)
friction.why: A satisfying payoff for a long chain (vacuum suit, Thermos, drill bit size, the balloon lift to the star, timer). The timer's millichron note made choosing the setting easy

friction.result: It chose the ELEVATOR shaft: you float helplessly, then pull yourself back
friction.why: There are two shafts in the room, and the bare word went to the elevator rather than the air shaft I had just opened. No 'which shaft?' question; it cost a turn

friction.result: Spills you into Computer Control: exercise machine attacks, 'Launch in 200 millichrons'; game unwinnable without jammer, 20-prong board and foil
friction.why: The one-way drop is fair (the Gym sign about 710, the foil, the board all hinted), and the unwinnable notice names exactly what was missing, which is very helpful. But nothing at the grating warns that it's a point of no return

r16-gm-full.diary:
# Playtest diary: r16-gm-full

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** the start of the game
- **Persona:** a tabletop game master who treats every character as a person, talks to Floyd and Plato constantly, asks everyone about everything and follows hunches from what they say
- **Model:** claude-opus-5-5
- **Seed:** 76825
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** off
- **Build commit:** 0ba77ff0
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 16
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-10-12/r16-gm-full.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

### Leg 1 (model: claude-opus-5-5)

**Cmds 1-10.** Started on Deck Twelve of the S.P.S. Duffy with three forms and a blueprints binder. Read all three forms through the paper viewer (transcriptions). The Assignment Completion form carries a navigational slip (time:course) - clearly needed later for a spacecraft. Wandered: aft is Forms Storage (boxes of absurd forms), starboard is Cargo Bay Entrance, fore of that is the Robot Pool with Rex, Helen and... Floyd! My old friend from Resida. As a GM-minded player I want to greet everyone and take Floyd along via the robot use form.

### Leg 2 (model: claude-opus-5-5)

Starting at Shady Dan's, score 17, day 2 time 5829.

**Cmds 401-418.** Turned on Dan's machine; went down to the Junk Yard, took off and dropped the magnetic boots there, and took my ID card (a welder, 'Welder Number 1', menaced me; fled up). Card in the small slot: "Current rank is 6: Lieutenant First Class. Enter new rank on keypad." Typed 9 -> "New rank is 9: HyperAdmiral." No points though. The detector said "getting warm" in the Junk Yard after I dropped the boots - searching the junk gave nothing. Plato keeps snapping "Please let me read in peace!".

**Cmds 419-445.** Trading Post W = Studio (artist's 'junk' sculpture): took a J-series hyperdiode from it - for the detonator! Trading Post N = Grocery (took plastic bag of vacuum taffy = food). Grocery N = Broadway: down Fortune Teller (crystal ball tips - joke), N Recruitment Office (posters), E Field Office (took + wore a miner's headlamp - for the dark rooms). Detector 'very warm' at Broadway. Plato announced "Tagging along after this simpleton human is becoming tiresome" and left, but came back. Broadway W -> Makeshift Connector W -> East Connection (hatch now frozen open). A fumble taught me the 7-item hand limit; packed the kit.

**Cmds 446-469.** HyperAdmiral card opens Sick Bay security door -> Brig (three locked cells, nothing found). Hunger+thirst at 6565 d2 -> ate the taffy. The platinum detector got 'warm', 'very warm', then 'too hot to handle' and I dropped it at North Connection - so it was heating over time, not homing in (I think). Turned it off, picked it up. Headlamp lit the dark Storage: a JAMMER (twenty sockets, freq 0-1400, set 337, off) - fits the 20-prong fromitz board and the Gym's frequency 710. File Room (lit): nothing but boring forms. Floyd and Plato wandered off.

**Cmds 470-488.** Plato now threatens: "If you do not cease this incessant interrogation, I shall teach you a lesson in manners you won't soon forget!" HyperAdmiral card opened the L6 Armory (+5, score 22): fusor-beam zapgun (indicator 7). Weight limit forced me to drop the empty bag and the (overheating) platinum detector in the Armory. Welder Number 3 attacked at End of Corridor - zapped it, it vanished (6 shots left?). Shipping Room (headlamp): forklift sign; boxes of binder-request forms.

**Cmds 489-525.** Bay #4 empty. Printing Plant: dropped the nectar (weight), plugged the 20-prong board into the jammer and set it to 710. L8 ladder "sealed off -- apparently from below"; elevator to 8 "whines momentarily, but doesn't move". Bay #3: swapped the blackened hyperdiode for the J-series one in the detonator (no points). Gym: with the jammer ON, the exercise machine "seems to be frozen"; off, I exercise normally. So the jammer at 710 freezes the machine - for some later moment (someone trapped? the machine attacks?). Headlamp dimming - turn it off when not needed. Saved in the Gym (score 22).

**Cmds 526-548.** Weary at 7542 d2 -> slept in Female Barracks (dream: "Open the pod bay doors, Floyd"). Woke NOVEM 6 (day 3); chronometer STOPPED (no time on status now). Floyd rude ("lazy slob", shoved me). Leaving the barracks, Plato stunned me and monologued: the Zeenak pyramid makes Hunji machines kill their makers and build a replica factory; "a hundred copies of this death-pyramid". I kept begging "floyd, help" - on the 4th turn Floyd knocked the stun gun away, Plato landed on it and was blown apart (+7, score 29). Floyd sobbing, wants to be left alone. Poor Floyd - and Plato was a friend, once. 'floyd, take the zapgun and shoot plato' -> shoot not understood; 'floyd, save me!' -> [I don't know the word "me!."].

**Cmds 549-585.** Floyd back to his usual self (sad). Oliver still incubating. Loan Shark: strong box with a HUGE lock. Alley NE = Warehouse: red sign "TRADING POST VACUUM STORAGE AREA Trespassers will be spaced!" over a closed inner door, down. Hunger+thirst again (day 3) -> Greasy Straw had nothing (counter: "open the counter first" then "You're wacko"), trekked to L7 and drank the nectar: "(That was the last food you will find.)" Cold coffee still in Paper Recycling (hands full). Rhythmic mechanical heartbeat from below - the replica factory?

**Cmds 586-634.** Floyd is surly again ("Oh, quit jabbering already"). Spacetruck radio: microphone missing. PX: kicking/reaching in the hole gives nothing. Broadway NE = Rec Shop (simulation booth, flavour); SE = Barbershop (mirror) - W Grocery; Grocery SE = Saloon - E (disguised) Casino. SPIN ROULETTE WHEEL -> exits up and north (+4, score 33). North = Opium Den (sign with mustache). Up = Flophouse: locker holds a SPACE SUIT. Weight forced me to leave the jammer and the survival kit in the Flophouse (took the Thermos out). Now wearing the suit.

**Cmds 635-669.** Warehouse -> Airlock (Floyd: "I'll wait here; it doesn't look like there's room in that phone booth for both of us"). First try, without magnetic boots: opened the lower door and was swept out - DIED (Lost in Space). Restored. Fetched the boots from the Junk Yard (left the HyperAdmiral ID card THERE so the boots can't wipe it). Second try: closed Thermos, closed upper door, opened lower, down -> 'In Space' vac yard (+3, score 36). Headlamp found a tiny cylinder: Frezone explosive. Opened the Thermos, put the explosive in, closed it. Back up, closed lower door, opened upper.

**Cmds 670-733.** Zapped the Loan Shark strong box's lock: box vaporized, leaving a galakmid coin (+5, 41). Fetched card (boots off) and kit; left jammer in Flophouse (weight). Broadway SW = Pet Store: leashed Arcturian balloon creature (hydrogen, floats). PX: coin in, type 6 -> "loud klunk" but nothing comes out; reach in hole: "You can just feel something with your fingertips, but you can't get a grip on it! (Someone with a longer reach might have better luck.)" Floyd had wandered off. Zapped Welder Number 4. Meanwhile: "(Even sealed in the Thermos bottle, the explosive is getting softer.)" then "...is melting". Drilled the safe with the small bit: toothpick hole, explosive doesn't fit -> restored, used the MEDIUM bit: pencil hole, explosive in (+3, 44). Attach detonator -> explosive sublimed: UNWINNABLE notice. Restoring the Warehouse save (33, before the vac yard). New order: timer FIRST (find Floyd/long reach), drill (medium bit) first, explosive LAST, then rush.

**Cmds 734-798.** Restored the Warehouse save (33). Left suit+boots in the Warehouse. Re-zapped the strong box, coin (+5, 38); card from Junk Yard; kit + jammer from Flophouse; swapped in the medium bit (small bit left in Flophouse). "floyd, follow me" -> "Okay!" (useful). PX: coin, type 6 -> klunk, stuck again. "floyd, reach in hole" -> "Nope, not even a ball." (Someone with a longer reach might have better luck.) So not Floyd. Plato (tall) is dead in every save I have. Workshop machinery 'outside your area of expertise'. Zapgun now 4. Drilled the safe with the medium bit (pencil hole) and left the spent drill in Commander's Quarters. Oliver still incubating; heating chamber has only a small opening. Floyd: "Oh, quit jabbering already" to everything.

### Leg 3 (model: claude-opus-5-5)

Starting at the Robot Shop, score 38, day 3, unsaved. Plan: solve the stuck PX timer. Memory (not the screen) whispers that Stationfall had an ostrich somewhere with a long neck; the Pet Store's untried SE exit is my first hunch.

**Cmds 801-840.** Saved in the Robot Shop (this silently replaced my Warehouse fallback - filed). Walked to the Pet Store with Floyd; hunger warning at once (day 3). Went to L7 and drank the cold coffee: "The coffee is poisoned!" - DIED. Restored the Robot Shop save. Back at the Pet Store: opened the cage, the balloon creature floated out (Floyd taunts it). Taking its leash: it farts, I drop everything; "(It doesn't seem to want to be dragged. Maybe it can be persuaded to follow something it wants.)" It eats airborne spores. Hunger again - no food anywhere; I must hurry.

**Cmds 841-861.** Broadway has no NW/up. Grocery shelves can't be searched. Trading Post SE = Shady Dan's. Alley SW = **Pawn Shop** (spray can "E-Z SPRAY SPORZ" - spores, the balloon's food!). Alley SE = **"Doc" Schuster's**: a 3-metre OSTRICH ("half its height is its neck" - the longer reach for the PX timer, as my memory guessed) and a letter about ostrich nip in someone's ceiling panel. Talking to the ostrich: "Dr. Blanchard ... would be fascinated".

**Cmds 862-900.** Alley N = Missionary (kook's home, nothing). Pet Store ceiling hides a panel: stick of ostrich nip (+3). Ostrich sniffs it and follows me (floats/swims in zero-g, bellyflops into gravity - lovely). At the PX: "put nip in hole" -> the ostrich sticks its head up, the timer falls out (+6, score 47); ostrich gets drunk on the nip. Saved at PX (47). Zapped welders 2 and 1. Hunger now critical: "If you don't eat or drink something in a few millichrons, you'll probably pass out."

**Cmds 901-979.** Collapsed from hunger at South Connection (died, 47). All saves are past the last food, so the game is lost from every save. Used the Robot Shop save as a scouting run against the hunger clock: nip -> ostrich -> timer (+3, +6), attached the detonator to the timer at the PX (allowed), Warehouse: card/jammer/zapgun dropped (weight), suit + boots, welder 2 zapped from the floor, airlock -> vac yard (+3, 50), explosive into the Thermos, back. The suit is "too bulky to fit through the partially dilated iris hatch" - took it off at Grimy Passage. Safe: explosive in hole (+3, 53), attach detonator to explosive (Footnote 13). "set timer to 5" -> the game explains the timer counts millichrons (action ~7, walk ~22). I tried to leave: "You'll have to disconnect the explosive first" (I was HOLDING the detonator+timer - must DROP them first). Timer hit 0: "sizzling sound from the detonator, and a burnt odor" - no explosion, and the J-series hyperdiode is GONE from the open detonator. So either the J-series diode is the wrong part (the puce spool hints at the Chapel star's diode) or something else was wrong. Restarting from the opening with a tight, food-aware plan.

**Cmds 980-1058 (RESTART).** Restarted from the opening (--new). First try: forgot to close the spacetruck hatch - "the truck's air gushes out" - died; the game's death note points out SAVE is free. Restarted again: Floyd (type 3), kit, CLOSE HATCH, pilot seat, form, time 4824 -> course 427, saved, launched, docked (+5) at 6071 d1 - and hungry at once (earlier than last game). The Mess Hall FDU sprays acid already on day 1; ate the orange goo. Plato met on L3 (day 1). Main Storage: detonator. Chapel: standing on the pulpit reveals it opens (switch); "plato, get the star" -> "Were I but several meters taller, I would happily oblige." Stamp under the Commander's bed; stamped the completion form. Welders 1 and 3 roam on day 1 now (dodged). Floyd fetched the medium bit (+3, score 8). Saved in the Robot Shop.

**Cmds 1059-1142.** L7: crumpled form from trash, stamped; ladder to L8 is sealed even on day 1. Drill: swapped in the medium bit; drilled the safe at once (the game warns the drill has one hole left - good warning). Laundry presser ironed the form; South Connection slot opened the village (+6). Bank: platinum detector (left). Mayor's: book. Junk Yard: boots (left - they'd wipe the card); the Alley->Junk Yard move printed the Studio text first (bug filed). Dan's machine: HyperAdmiral. Welder 1 menaced, fled. Pet Store nip (+3); Field Office headlamp; Grocery taffy; Greasy Straw nectar (look behind counter). Armory zapgun (+5, 22). Saved (3 slots now full). Floyd and Plato follow again.

**Cmds 1143-1201.** Weary at 8141 d1 -> slept in the Female Barracks (+3, 25); woke day 2 at 1642 with everything dropped beside the bed (the 7-item hand limit fumbled the nectar). Loan Shark strong box zapped -> coin (+5, 30). Pawn Shop spray can. Ostrich from Doc's to the PX (Floyd: "Wow! An elephant!"); zapped Welders 2 and 1 on the way; hunger at 2049 d2 -> gray goo. Coin, type 6, nip in hole -> timer (+6, 36), saved at the PX. Blackened hyperdiode: "so charred you can't even tell what series it is" - so the series matters (J-series burned out last game). East Connection hatch is already frozen open on day 2: shortcut east to the village. Leg ended in the Makeshift Connector.

## Clue log

(Every clue word for word: who wrote or said it, where you found it, what it might mean.)

- **Form JZ-59-G (package paper):** "Applicable robot pool: Deck Five"; "this form should be given to any party or parties thereabouts responsible for the discharge of robots, or, if the indicated pool is automated, to the appropriate automated system". Means: put the form in the robot pool slot, type a selection on the keypad. (Hmm: says Deck Five, but this pool is on Deck Twelve.)
- **Form QX-17-T (package paper):** not validated (game says "You notice that it has not been validated"). Contains the astrogator's slip "time:course", e.g. 5500-5549: 224, 5550-5599: 213, 5600-5649: 203, 6600-6649: 103 ... full table in transcription FORM1-QX-17-T.md. Likely the course to type into a spacecraft autopilot at a given time.
- **Form HB-56-V:** Class Three spacecraft activation; lists "FORMS TRANSPORT SPACETRUCK" etc. Probably hand to a spacecraft slot.
- **Deck Twelve:** "Next to the door is a slot." (port door, to the rest of the Duffy).
- **Robot Pool:** slot for inserting form + keypad for typing selection. Bins: 1 Rex (heavy lifting), 2 Helen (forms bursting), 3 Floyd.
- **Spacetruck recording:** "Safety precautions forbid the activation of the vehicle unless both the pilot and copilot seats are occupied." Floyd: "You first."
- **Approach view:** "In the center is the large, spherical Command Module. Jutting "north" from it is a smaller Sub-Module. Joining the Command Module, at its two other connection points, is a tangle of tubes and space bubbles and derelict rockets. These form a "village"". Docking: "Docking bay one is occupied. Defaulting to bay two." - who is in bay one?
- Floyd: "Floyd could sure use a phone book!" (seat too low) - maybe a joke, maybe a hint.
- **Plato (Workshop):** "I have not seen a soul for a day now, perhaps more." "I don't have a very specific function ... but I do keep the library organized." Unknown topics: "I'll be sure to see what I can find the next time I'm in the station's library". -> there is a library; Plato may learn things there.
- **Station Control monitors:** COMMUNICATION RED, LIFE SUPPORT GREEN, FOOD PRODUCTION RED, GRAVITY GREEN, COMPUTER GREEN, POWER GREEN, PRINTING YELLOW. -> comm and food are broken; food may become a problem.
- **Commander's Office:** log reader "tiny red button and a microphone/speaker ... no log tape in it" -> find a log tape.
- **Robot Shop:** robot "Oliver", not yet woken; "incubation period ... two to twenty days". Floyd: "If we be here when Oliver wakes up, Floyd would like to teach Oliver to play paddleball."
- **Sick Bay:** "an ID reader indicates a security door" (east). My ID: nothing happens -> need someone else's ID / higher clearance.
- **Commander's Quarters:** safe "a dial with 8000 settings. There are probably between twelve and twenty numbers in the combination." Log tape notation: "Commander's Log -- 11349.12.2 through 11349.12.4".
- **Commander's log (gravelly voice, log reader):**
  - 12.2.3800: "Some kripping jokers have been pilfering the station's fuel cells to go out on joyrides! I have hidden the fuel cells up in the Dome's storage bin, slapped a lock on the bin, and deposited the key in my safe!"
  - 12.2.5100: "Reproductions Officer Hausberg reports that collater #22 is off-line for routine service. Estimates one or two days downtime. Also, unidentified craft detected in sector. No response to hailings. Sending Finsterwald to intercept."
  - 12.2.6750: "Unidentified craft towed to Docking Bay #1. ... single-cabin vessel of unfamiliar alien origin. The only things aboard were the remains of one of the aliens, and a featureless pyramid. ... a used-spaceship dealer in the village named Shady Dan is selling modified Patrol ID cards. Liaison Officer Bumblewitz is investigating."
  - 12.3.1900: "Professor Schmidt has back-plotted the course of the alien vessel ... may be of extra-galactic origin."
  - 12.3.5100: "No cooperation from Shady Dan, so I'm putting the village off-limits ... No more village entry forms will be validated."
  - 12.3.5250: "Some kripping joker snuck into my office and validated a whole batch of village entry forms! ... I'll hide the stamp under my bed ... I gave Schmidt permission to move the alien pyramid to the holding tank in the Sci Sub-Module ... the alien skeleton is too brittle to move ... This log reader is overheating. I'll have to dig out the spare."
  - 12.3.7700: "Equipment Officer Mertzhoffer ... several unexplainable breakdowns in the Gymnastic Equipment and the Laundering Machinery ... could it be sabotage?"
  - 12.4.1650: Duffy emergency request for the forms; "the #22 collater should be available to prepare the forms."
  - 12.4.1850: "unexpected shutdown of web-feeder #17 ... Now the spare log reader is overheating, also!"
  - 12.4.1900: "ensigns in the filing division was seriously injured when one of the hull welders malfunctioned. She's in Sick Bay now ... What the krip!..." (log ends)
  - Theory: the alien pyramid is making machines go haywire. The stamp under the bed validates forms (my completion form; village entry forms). Safe holds the Dome bin key.
- **Wake-up note (game):** "(The station is noticeably worse than yesterday, and your rations won't last forever. Whatever needs doing, doing it sooner looks wise.)"
- **Blueprints:** Level 1 Garden+Observatory Dome; L2 Mess Hall, Library, Meeting Rooms, Main Storage; L3 Gym, Theatre, Chapel, Laundry; L4 barracks, Bay #3; L5 command, Sick Bay, PX (north corridor NE), Brig (behind Sick Bay's security door S), Robot Shop, File Room, Workshop, Storage; L6 Officers' Quarters, Aux barracks, Bays #1/#4, Armory (security door), Shipping Room; L7 Printing Plant, Paper Recycling; L8 Power, Oxygen, Water Purification, Arti-Grav (access hatches); L9 Main Computer, Computer Control. Sub-modules: Scientific (north), Military (east), Diplomatic (south).
- **PX Vendo-Matic screen:** "all items: 1 galakmid ... 6. All-Purpose Timer ... 9. Large Drill Bit" (all else SOLD OUT). Need a coin.
- **Schmidt's diary (Engineering Office):** alien ship path leads out of the galaxy, "ship and the pyramid are probably well over one billion years old!" Wall markings "A series of identical dots ... Schmidt studied the dots for nonvisual properties ... "I guess my pal, the mayor, will get to show off his linguistic training."" Failures of lab machinery around the pyramid. -> the mayor (of the village?) can read the alien dots; maybe the dots are tactile/sound.
- **Bio Office note (blood-stained):** "Schmidt -- Why didn't I see it until now! Just think of this station as a cell and the pyramid as a mechanized bacterioph" -> the pyramid is a machine virus taking over station machinery (welders, doors, FDU).
- **Holding Tank Level:** "The thick side wall of the tank has been blasted open, and the tank is completely empty."
- **Plato:** book = "Some early poems by Ignatius Tomato." Floyd: "Ask Plato. He knows everything!"
- **Mess Hall FDU:** "a user simply turns on the unit and immediately receives a ... meal" - but now shoots acid.
- **Dome bin:** sign "Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies"; "A lock has been newly welded to the bin. The bin is warm to the touch."
- **Detonator (Main Storage):** "two connection points"; inside "a blackened hyperdiode".
- **Comm Center screen:** "From: Forms Control Officer, S.P.S. Duffy ... Two thousand reams ... found in mislabelled pallet. No additional supplies needed. Abort assignment and return to Duffy."
- **Monitors day 2 ~2984:** COMMUNICATION RED, LIFE SUPPORT YELLOW, FOOD PRODUCTION RED, GRAVITY YELLOW, COMPUTER GREEN, POWER YELLOW, PRINTING RED.
- **Alien ship dots (visual):** line1 ".. .."; line2 ".. .... . ... . ... ... . ..."; line3 ".. ... ."; line4 ".... . ... ."; line5 ".. ... ."
- **Alien skeleton:** "an unusually overdeveloped tongue case."
- **Lick dots (taste text, verbatim):** "(sweet/slightly-bitter) (sweet/very-sour) / (sweet/very-sweet) (sour/bland/bland/sour) (very-salty) (very-sweet/bland/sour) (bland) (bland/salty/sour) (bitter/sour/very-sour) (slightly-sour) (bitter/salty/bitter) / (very-sweet/very-salty) (spicy-hot/bland/bland) (very-sweet) / (sour/bland/sour/sweet) (bland) (very-salty/salty/sour) (very-sweet) / (bland/bitter) (bland/sour/very-sour) (very-salty)." -> each taste = a letter? friction.why: A lovely chain of reasoning from the pet store sign, the spray can and the creature's fear of the flame; every step was hinted on screen

friction.command: inventory (after Plato's stun ambush in the Alley)
friction.result: You are empty-handed - everything was left floating in the Alley
friction.why: The stun scene says I 'crumple into a floating heap' but never says I let go of what I carried; I walked six rooms with a melting explosive before finding out

friction.command: set timer to 45 / west / south / wait
friction.result: Loud but distant explosion; safe blown open, key inside (+7)
friction.why: The timer note (action ~7, walk ~22, '45 runs out after about 3 walks') made the timing easy to plan once I knew the explosive's 100-millichron limit from the instruction sheet

friction.result: Spills me into Computer Control with the exercise machine; notice: unwinnable without the jammer, the twenty-prong fromitz board, the zapgun and the reflective foil
friction.why: The one-way drop gave no warning before it; the notice afterwards at least named what I lacked (I had never seen any reflective foil). The notice told me what to fetch, so it helped as well as hurt

friction.result: The light from the headlamp flickers and dies! It is now too dark to see.
friction.why: After the station lights go out (~4235 day 2) the only light is a headlamp that has been warning 'somewhat dimmer' for a long time; I could not tell how much life it had left, and it died mid-search

r16-newcomer-full.diary:
# Playtest diary: r16-newcomer-full

- **Mode:** click
- **Start:** the start of the game
- **Persona:** a first-time player of text adventures in their twenties who grew up on mobile games, taps whatever looks interactive, reads quickly and gets bored by long descriptions
- **Model:** claude-opus-5-5
- **Seed:** 13553
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** off
- **Build commit:** 0ba77ff0
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 16
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-10-12/r16-newcomer-full.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

(About 100 words per 10 commands: what you tried, and what you believed.)

**Leg 1 (claude-opus-5-5).** Cmds 1-15: Tapped the slot by the port door with my ID card: it just spat it back. Went aft to a giant Forms Storage Room (boxes of silly form names). Starboard to Cargo Bay Entrance, fore to Robot Pool. Put the Robot Use form in the slot, the third robot turned out to be Floyd (I half-remember Floyd from Planetfall lore — memory, not screen). Typed 3 on the keypad and Floyd hugged me. Keypad number menu was easy. Score still 0. Plan: cargo bay next, the spacecraft form probably goes in a ship there.

Cmds 16-34: Cargo bay, opened spacetruck hatch, took survival kit. Activation form spat back until both seats filled; sat in pilot seat and Floyd hopped in copilot. Form accepted: "Type in the course heading." Looked it up on the QX-17-T slip (time 5609 -> 5600-5649 -> 203). Typed 203. Saved, waited... and DIED: hatch was open (I'd tried to close it from the seat — "can't reach"). Restored, stood, closed hatch, sat, waited. Docked: +5, score 5. Got "pretty hungry and thirsty" warning at docking -> opened kit, ate orange goo (apricot yogurt). Trying blue soup said neither hungry nor thirsty, and a helpful hint that I'll be hungry again in ~319 moves.

Cmds 35-~75: Walked off the truck into Level Five. Workshop (took 20-ohm bedistor), dark Storage beyond (no light). Hull welders keep "quivering with excitement" at me; I just walk away. Floyd met Plato, a library robot. PX has a coin vending machine (need a galakmid). Sick Bay security door won't take my ID. Comm Center beacon shocks me. Station Control board shows Comms + Food red. Commander's Office has a log reader; tape was on the Commander's desk next door. Played the whole log — loads of clues (see log): stamp under the Commander's bed, fuel-cell key in safe, alien pyramid in the Sci Sub-Module. Log reading by pushing the red button over and over was smooth.

Cmds ~76-120: Looked under the Commander's bed -> validation stamp. Log reader exploded behind me (black scar). South: Briefing Room, South Connection (Diplomatic iris hatch + slot), Robot Shop with sleeping robot Oliver and a heating chamber holding a medium drill bit — too hot/small for my hand, but "Tell Floyd to > Take" got it (+3, score 8). File Room SW of South Junction is dark. Level Four: barracks (cubicles empty), SanFac, Docking Bay #3 with a lilac nanofilm spool (took). Level Three: Gym (sign about frequency 710; machine sabotaged per log, didn't touch), Theatre with projection booth + lock. Got "You begin to feel weary" in Theatre -> went straight to Female Barracks bed, slept: +3 (11). New day NOVEM 5, time 1620. Game warns station is worse and rations won't last. I'd dropped everything on the bed; "Take all" button picked it up. Saved.

Cmds ~121-160: Auto-doors now open "sluggishly" and zoom shut — station decaying. Laundry: dryer, presser (empty; washer missing). Chapel: puce spool, blinking seven-pointed star out of reach, pulpit hides a switch that toggles the eternal flame. Up to Level Two: Mess Hall (cold coffee; the food unit sprays ACID), Main Storage with a detonator (opened: blackened hyperdiode — broken). Meeting Rooms 1+2, Library with a nanofilm reader. Hungry+thirsty again at ~2028 -> ate blue soup. Only gray goo left! Spools: lilac = spacetruck fuel-cell replacement (quarnum wrench), puce = chapel maintenance mentioning the star's (hyper)diode. Both end with the reader laughing "You will die, human!" Welders keep stalking me; walking away works.

Cmds ~160-245: Dome on top: locked, warm "Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies" bin (fuel cells). Saved. Elevator works via keypad (typed 6). Level Six: Aux Barracks/SanFac, Officers' Quarters A/B/C (nothing), End of Corridor with another security door, dark Shipping Room, Docking Bay #1 (alien ship: empty pedestal, dot pattern, skeleton), Docking Bay #4 (empty). P.A. said a message came in -> Comm Center screen: Duffy says ABORT and return. So now the goal is getting home (fuel!). Blueprint key is just symbols (no hints). Science Sub-Module via the Tube: Engineering Office (Schmidt's diary), Astro Lab (fromitz board), Astro Office, Scientists' Quarters, Bio Lab/Office (bloody note), Holding Tank blasted open, empty. Dropped diary/note/lilac spool to stop fumbling.

Cmds ~245-275: Printing Plant (Level 7) trash can -> crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form FW-83-Q; validated it with the stamp. Paper Recycling Plant -> a tired drill with small bit (took). Ladder to Level 8 is sealed from below. Elevator to 3, Laundry presser: form in, close, turn on, wait (steam billows), turn off, open -> "neatly ironed" + "validated". Walked to South Connection, put the form in the hatch slot: hatch half-opens into a dingy tube. +6 -> score 17. Saved. Next: explore the village (Shady Dan, the mayor who reads dots, maybe a coin/food).

Cmds ~275-315: Into the (deserted, weightless) village. Travel Agency (posters), Bank (platinum detector - took, turned on; dropped the stamp there), Main Street, Greasy Straw (searched counter: cup of Ramosian Fire Nectar - took; dropped mauve spool), Trading Post (sign: FREZONE explosive; instruction sheet + 12-prong fromitz board floating - not yet taken, a welder chased me off), Grocery (plastic bag of vacuum taffy). Hungry+thirsty #3 at 4297 -> ate the last gray goo. Uniform can hold papers (put QX form in it). Broadway: Recruitment Office, Field Office with a miner's HEADLAMP (wearing it - light at last!), Rec Shop with simulation booths.

Cmds ~315-345: Barbershop: detector "quietly beeping" but nothing found (mirror affixed). Saloon -> Casino (dice, roulette wheel). Trading Post instruction sheet = FREZONE explosive how-to (safe plan!). Studio scrap sculpture had a J-series hyperdiode -> swapped it into the detonator (no points). Pet Store: Arcturian balloon creature in a cage (hydrogen, smelly) + leash; detector got "warm" so I dropped it there (fear of exploding like the log reader). Shady Dan's: "innocuous machine" changes ID rank: card in slot, typed 9 -> "New rank is 9: HyperAdmiral." Card back in my uniform. Should now open the security doors.

Cmds ~345-400: Warehouse below Trading Post (vacuum storage airlock, "Trespassers will be spaced!"), Alley, Missionary, Junk Yard (magnetic boots - game warned they'd wipe my ID card, so I left them), Loan Shark (strong box, HUGE lock), Mayor's Office (textbook; glossary paper of a taste-language). Back to the station: File Room by headlamp (boring files). HyperAdmiral card opened Sick Bay's security door (empty Brig) and Level Six's (Armory: +5 -> 22, fusor-beam zapgun with "7"). East Military hatch is now frozen open: Makeshift Connector -> Broadway. Shipping Room by headlamp: pallets of the very forms I came for; sign about returning the forklift. Saved in Armory. Leg ends at End of Corridor, score 22, healthy.

**Leg 2 (claude-opus-5-5).** Cmds 401-425: Went into the Alien Ship and TASTED the dots (menu had Taste). With the Mayor's glossary it reads roughly "Brethren Hunji: sabotage failed. I have found the Zeenak weapon's only weakness: element 78 [platinum]. Turn back the deadly radiations." So platinum beats the pyramid. Lit the headlamp and explored the dark Storage N of the Workshop: a JAMMER (black box, antenna, 20 tiny sockets, freq 0-1400, was 337). Set it to 710 and took it to the Gym: turned on, nothing happened; got in the machine, "permanently on". I think the jammer needs a twenty-prong fromitz board in its sockets (I carried one in leg 1 but no longer have it - must have dropped it somewhere). Saved "Gym".
Cmds 426-442: Walked to the village via the East hatch. On Broadway: "A growl from your stomach warns that you're getting pretty hungry and thirsty" (~6552 d2) -> ate the vacuum taffy at once (boysenberry); diagnose: well-fed. NO food left now. Barbershop: mirror menu More... had Break -> mirror smashed into dust, leaving a reflective foil (+4, score 26). Platinum foil, I bet (element 78 = the pyramid's weakness). Saved "Barbershop, score 26".
Cmds 443-460: Broadway Down = Fortune Teller: crystal ball ("Tips: Be general with your predictions... wave your hands around the crystal ball"). Gazing into it triggered PLATO's betrayal: he stunned me (paralysed, can still speak) and monologued: the Zeenak pyramid turns machines against their makers and builds replicas; "a hundred copies of this death-pyramid" will spread. Telling Floyd to Turn off Plato / Take ray / Help -> "Floyd in quandry". Waited: Floyd knocked the gun away, Plato landed on it and exploded. +7 -> 33. Took everything back (hands full; game suggested what to drop - nice). Saved "Fortune Teller, score 33" (over Barbershop slot). Floyd is grieving.
Cmds 461-482: Broadway NW is a joke ("openings in ALMOST every direction"). Pet Store: detector beeps (because of my foil, I think). Hunted for my lost twenty-prong fromitz board: found it floating in the Junk Yard. Put the empty plastic bag into the survival kit to free a hand, then put the board into the jammer: "It has a twenty-prong fromitz board plugged into it... on... 710". Alley SE = "Doc" Schuster's: letter + ostrich + 20 cm disposal hole. Dropped the letter there.
Cmds 483-500: Alley SW = Pawn Shop: spray can "E-Z SPRAY SPORZ (tm) A mixture of high-quality spores / Lowest gas-inducement levels of any brand!" (balloon creature food!). Hands full -> dropped the detonator in the Pawn Shop, took the can. Loan Shark: saved, then zapgun Shoot -> strong box -> "vaporized, leaving a solitary coin!" Took it: +5 -> 38. Coin: "ONE GALAKMID Third Galactic Union". Put it in my uniform. Next: PX timer (or large drill bit).
Cmds 501-520: Airlock below the Warehouse (stencil "SECURE ALL OPEN CONTAINERS BEFORE DEPRESSURIZATION."): closed my kit and the inner door, opened the outer door -> lungs rupture, DIED. Restored Loan Shark, re-zapped the box, coin again (38), saved. Alley W is another "ALMOST every direction" joke. Missionary: nothing. Picked up the mauve spool from the Greasy Straw (to read in the Library). Pet Store: examining the CEILING revealed a panel -> stick of ostrich nip (+3 -> 41). Saved "Pet Store, score 41". Next: feed the nip to the ostrich at Doc Schuster's.
Cmds 521-545: In the Warehouse: "You begin to feel weary. It might be time to think about finding a nice safe place to sleep." (~7527 d2). Saved; Sleep there -> "Members of civilized societies usually sleep in beds." Walked straight back to the station; Sick Bay has beds. Got in, slept: NOVEM 6 (day 3). No points for sleeping this time. "You glance at your chronometer, and realize with annoyance that it has stopped." The status line no longer shows the time - worrying, since the course home depends on the time! Floyd is getting rude (kicks the mattress, shoves me, curses) - the pyramid getting to him? Took all back.
Cmds 546-585: PX: coin in slot, typed 6 -> "loud klunk... nothing appears". Kicking did nothing; Tell Floyd -> "Reach into the dispenser" -> "Nope, not even a ball. (Someone with a longer reach might have better luck.)" -> the OSTRICH! Walked to Doc Schuster's; the ostrich sniffed the nip and followed me all the way (bellyflop when entering gravity, lol). In the PX: put the nip in the hole -> ostrich sticks its head up, timer falls out, ostrich eats the nip and passes out. +6 -> 47. Timer: "standard, all-purpose timer... any number up to 100... one connection point." Dropped the spray can in the PX (kit full). In the Grocery: "A growl from your stomach warns that you're getting pretty hungry and thirsty" (day 3) - diagnose "fairly hungry and thirsty". NO FOOD. Saved "PX, score 47". Two refused volleys were my own mistake (I fired a second call before reading).
Cmds 586-690: FOOD CRISIS. Station Control board now: everything GREEN except PRINTING RED (food production green!). Went to the Mess Hall: drank the "thick brown" coffee -> "The coffee is poisoned!" DIED; restored PX. Saved in the Mess Hall, turned on the FDU: still acid ("Today's menu features sausage, frobbled eggs, and teakberry juice... a stream of acid shoots out"). Warnings: "You're now really ravenous and your lips are quite parched" -> diagnose "very hungry and thirsty" -> "You're starting to feel faint" -> "If you don't eat or drink something in a few millichrons, you'll probably pass out" -> "You collapse from extreme thirst and hunger" DIED (Grocery), about 75 moves after the first day-3 warning. Searched Bank (stamp only), Travel Agency, Greasy Straw (counter: "You'll have to open the counter first" but no Open in menu; examine "nothing on the counter"), Saloon, Casino (dice, roulette), Rec Shop (booth: nothing), Recruitment, Field Office, Mayor's (textbook), spacetruck (radio, beacon), Briefing Room, Commander's wardrobe ("personal items of little interest"), SanFac ("doesn't go into that sort of detail"). No food anywhere. I think the Ramosian Fire Nectar (lost in leg 1) was my last ration. Restored PX again and am using the dying timeline to learn: drilling the safe with the small bit: first a warning "this drill sounds as if it has one job left in it" (nice!), then "You drill a hole in the safe approximately the diameter of a toothpick." (probably too small for Frezone; the medium or the PX Large Drill Bit is likely needed - but the coin bought the timer...).
Cmds 690-700: File Room by headlamp: no nectar. DECISION: none of my three saves (Mess Hall d3, PX d3, Warehouse d2) can be won - each runs into the day-3 hunger with no food left (my 4 rations: orange goo, blue soup, gray goo, vacuum taffy; the 5th, the Ramosian Fire Nectar from the Greasy Straw counter, got lost somewhere in leg 1). Per the rules I restart from the opening and replay faster with what I know, guarding every ration (and the nectar!).

**Leg 2, replay from the opening (claude-opus-5-5).** Cmds ~650-735: Restarted. Robot Pool form + 3 -> Floyd; truck: kit, close hatch FIRST, sit, activation form, time 5167 -> course 313 (slip 5150-5199). Docked +5 at 6414 with the hunger warning -> ate orange goo. Dropped the binder in the truck. Saved "Spacetruck day 1 score 5". Stamp under the Commander's bed; Floyd wandered off before the Robot Shop, so the drill bit waits. Printing Plant trash -> crumpled form, validated with the stamp (stamp menu "Validate..."); drill from Paper Recycling. Laundry presser: open, put form in, close, turn on, wait, turn off, open -> "neatly ironed Illegal Space Village Entry Form FW-83-Q". Much faster now that I know the way (~85 commands to here vs ~270 in leg 1).
Cmds ~735-760: Entry form in the South Connection slot (+6 -> 11), saved "South Connection d1 11". Greasy Straw ("You catch a whiff of something mouth-watering"): search counter -> cup of Ramosian Fire Nectar -> put INTO THE SURVIVAL KIT. Grocery: vacuum taffy bag (welder chased me, walked away). Field Office headlamp (worn). Barbershop: break mirror, foil (+4 -> 15). Pet Store ceiling panel: nip (+3 -> 18). Saved "Pet Store d1 18" at time 7617 - day 1! Way ahead of leg 1's pace.
Cmds ~760-780: Shady Dan's: card in slot, keypad 9 -> "Nothing happens" until I turned the machine ON ("Current rank is 6...") then 9 -> HyperAdmiral; card back in uniform; dropped the stamp there. Took Plato + Floyd to the Fortune Teller and gazed in the ball: only the "Tips" message - the Plato betrayal is NOT triggered by the ball; it must be timed (it came on day 2 ~6686 in the first run). The East Connection hatch is already frozen open on day 1 (Broadway W -> Makeshift -> East Connection).
Cmds ~780-800: Floyd fetched the medium drill bit (+3 -> 21). HyperAdmiral card opened the Level Six security door -> Armory (+5 -> 26), zapgun. "You begin to feel weary" (8126 d1) -> straight to the Auxiliary Barracks bed (Level Six N), slept (+3 -> 29), woke NOVEM 5 at 1653 with the "station is noticeably worse... rations won't last forever" note. Took the jammer from the dark Storage (headlamp), set to 710. Leg ends at Level Five, score 29, day 2 time 1859, well fed and rested.

**Leg 3 (claude-opus-5-5).** Starting at Level Five, score 29, day 2 time 1859 (replay run). Plan: detonator + Studio hyperdiode, alien dots, Loan Shark coin, ostrich timer, Plato at ~6600 day 2, find the twenty-prong board, look for a spacesuit, solve food on day 3.
Cmds 801-835: Main Storage: dropped the jammer (no room), took the detonator. Hungry at 2062 d2 (Level Four) -> ate gray goo at once. Village via the East hatch: Studio (odd stray 'Junk Yard' heading, filed), blackened hyperdiode out, J-series in. Alley garbage: nothing. Loan Shark: zapped box, coin (+5 -> 34), saved. Ostrich followed me from Doc Schuster's all the way to the PX; coin, 6, nip in the hole -> timer (+6 -> 40). Plato calls me a 'simpleton human' and leaves with Floyd - the betrayal is coming. Food left: Thermos, nectar, taffy.
Cmds 836-860: Carried everything to the Commander's Quarters. Swapped the small bit for the medium bit; the drill warned "one hole left" (with a helpful explanation), then drilled a hole "approximately the diameter of a pencil" in the safe (saved first: 'Commander's Quarters' save slot replaced Aux Barracks). Left drill, both bits, detonator (J-series inside) and timer by the safe. One refused volley: my own mistake (I guessed the code). Next: Frezone. Idea: carry it in the Thermos (keeps it cold, sheet says under 150 K). Need a way into vacuum: suit? Floyd (robots don't breathe)?
Cmds 861-945: Sci Sub-Module: twenty-prong board in the Astro Lab (Scientists' Quarters wardrobe: nothing). Jammer from Main Storage, board in, ON at 710 in the Gym; got in the exercise machine: "permanently on", nothing else. Saved "Gym". Theatre lock: zapped it, nothing. Plato ambushed me at Level Five (3690): I only waited and DIED (Floyd ran off). Restored Gym; Plato struck again at the Makeshift Connector (3722): Tell Floyd > Save you, > Turn off Plato, > Help!, > Take the stun ray -> Floyd knocks the gun away, Plato explodes (+7 -> 47). Saved "Makeshift Connector" (over Loan Shark).
Cmds 946-975: Searching for a way into the vacuum storage. Airlock: Floyd won't fit ("phone booth"); the outer door "won't budge" while the inner door is open (interlock). Floyd's Tell menu offers only Say hello / Follow / Help! outside the Plato scene. Asked Floyd about the foil: "Floyd loves anything reflective!" Recruitment Office, Field Office, Rec Shop booth: nothing. Heading for the Level Six docking bays and Shipping Room to look for a suit.
Cmds 976-1010: Hungry at 4318 d2 -> ate the blue soup (Thermos now empty, kept for the Frezone). Docking Bay #4 empty; Shipping Room sign wants the forklift returned (no forklift there). Elevator keypad 8: "whines momentarily, but doesn't move". Printing Plant: clanging from Level 8 below; ladder sealed from below; found the mauve spool lying there. Library: mauve spool = collater repair (fromitz board!).
Cmds 1011-1045: Paper Recycling: "vibration... feeling of dread" again. Docking Bay #1 doors now "almost nipping your heels". Floyd: "Oh, quit jabbering already." Spacetruck: SB radio = country music. READ THE BLUEPRINTS (only readable near the binder in the truck): every level has a "utility shaft and air duct" south of the elevator; Level 8 has a small room west of the elevator with access hatches to Oxygen Generation, Arti-Grav Unit, Power Plant, Water Purification; Level 9 = Computer Banks + Computer Control. The Dome's air shaft grating is the top of it ("securely affixed"; zapping only makes it glow - restored to save the charge). Dome S path just loops; shrubbery not edible.
Cmds 1046-1085: Systematic sweep for a suit / a way down: FDU description only; Chapel (puce spool still there, star blinking); Docking Bay #3 (lilac spool); Male Barracks wardrobe (nothing); Storage by lamp (empty now); Station Control board on day 2 at 5804: COMMUNICATION RED, LIFE SUPPORT YELLOW, FOOD PRODUCTION RED, GRAVITY YELLOW, COMPUTER GREEN, POWER RED, PRINTING RED; Robot Shop: Oliver "won't be possible until his incubation period ends", heating chamber "cleans or sterilizes small tools"; Briefing Room empty. Auto-doors now "almost nipping your heels!"
Cmds 1086-1115: Commander's wardrobe: nothing. Comm Center screen: same abort message. Pet Store: opened the cage; taking the leash makes the balloon creature fart in my face and I drop everything ("It doesn't seem to want to be dragged. Maybe it can be persuaded to follow something it wants."). Took the SPORZ can from the Pawn Shop; spraying it made the creature dart around with its mouth open, but it still won't be leashed or follow. Junk Yard: the boots warning now says a second take wipes the card. Validated my QX-17-T form with the stamp (no points). Noticed that the Studio/Junk Yard first-visit headings are swapped (filed).
Cmds 1116-1130: Hungry at 6578 d2 -> ate the vacuum taffy; only the nectar is left. Re-tested the airlock with a save: "As the door opens, the air in the lock whooshes out into the vacuum of space. Your lungs rupture..." - restored. Missionary, Mayor's Office: nothing new. Greasy Straw counter now says "You'll have to open the counter first" but no menu has Open (filed). Took the twelve-prong board. Floyd is now nasty ("Oh, quit jabbering already", stomps on my foot, curses my ancestors). Crystal ball: same tips.
Cmds 1131-1145: BREAKTHROUGH. Casino: roulette wheel > Turn -> "exits appear above you and to the north!" (+4 -> 51). North = Opium Den (anti-drug sign with a mustache). Up = Flophouse: bed + locker; locker > Open -> SPACE SUIT. Wearing it now. Saved "Casino, score 51" (over Makeshift). One more refused volley: my own fault again (two calls at once).
Cmds 1146-1200: Dropped the ID card in the Warehouse, wore the space suit; first try through the airlock: "the air in the lock whooshes out... taking you along for the ride" -> Lost in Space, died. Restored, put on the magnetic boots too (card left behind so it isn't wiped): survived; went Down into the "vac yard" (+3 -> 54); headlamp showed the Frezone "explosive" (pencil-sized cylinder). Put it in the Thermos, closed it, closed the kit, back through the airlock (closing the outer door re-pressurizes). Weary at 7573. Suit too bulky for the Makeshift hatch -> dropped it there. In the Commander's Quarters I saved, then slept: woke day 3 with "The game can no longer be won: the explosive was gone when you woke". Restored; put the explosive in the hole (+3 -> 57), connected detonator to explosive and timer, set the timer (4 by mistake, then 60; the game helpfully explains 7 per action / 22 per walk), walked out, waited: NO BLAST; the explosive "sublimes into a puff of FREZONE gas" (unwinnable again). My guess: the detonator was still OPEN from the hyperdiode swap. Restored the pre-sleep save, closed the detonator, connected it to the timer, saved. Leg spent.

**Leg 4 (claude-opus-5-5), 300 commands left of the cap.** Cmds 1201-1232: Ran the bomb from the best save: kit open, Thermos open, explosive in hole (+3 -> 57), detonator connected to explosive, timer 50, walked W/NW, waited: NOTHING. Timer at 0, the detonator opened EMPTY (the J-series hyperdiode had vanished), explosive sublimed -> unwinnable. Restored the move-496 save (hyperdiode visibly in the open detonator), closed it, explosive in hole, connected detonator->explosive, timer->detonator, set 30, stood in the Commander's Office: again silence; hyperdiode gone again. Filed as a high bug/confusion. Theory: the J-series is the wrong diode and burns out (the puce spool talks about the CHAPEL STAR's diode). New plan: restored "In Space" (7480 d2), leave the Frezone in the cold vac yard, go sleep, then get the chapel star's diode.
Cmds 1233-1300: Left the Frezone in the vac yard, walked to the Flophouse to sleep (weary 7556). Died sleeping in the space suit (air ran out, lol); then the headlamp left on burned out overnight -> unwinnable; third try (suit off, lamp off) woke on day 3 fine. Saved "Flophouse day 3". Chapel: shot the star with the zapgun -> "the star is gone, and the hyperdiode inside it" (unwinnable) = confirms the star diode is the right one. Restored. Hunger at North Junction -> drank the nectar: "(That was the last food you will find.)"
Cmds 1300-1328: Balloon creature: in zero-gee taking the leash always fails ("Perhaps it would behave differently somewhere with gravity"). TRICK: spray the SPORZ can in the NEXT room and the creature "farts in" after the spores; room by room into the station's gravity. Taking the leash in gravity: it hyperinflates and lifts me 2 m off the deck (way to reach the star!). A welder killed me while I hung there; restored, zapped the welder (vanished). Then the can ran EMPTY at Level Three, one room short of the Chapel (unwinnable). Restored the Flophouse save; the trip Pet Store->Chapel needs 9 sprays, no wasting.
Cmds 1329-1430: From the Flophouse day-3 save: 9 sprays lured the creature Broadway -> Makeshift -> East Connection -> East Junction -> North Junction -> Level Five -> (ladder) Four -> Three -> Chapel (can still had a puff). Turned off the eternal flame (pulpit switch), took the leash (lifted 2 m), took the star (+7 -> 61), let go (Down). Star opened: M-series hyperdiode. Drank the nectar at the next hunger. Suit (Flophouse) + boots (Trading Post, zapped a welder), closed kit, airlock, vac yard (lamp on), explosive into the Thermos, back. Commander's Quarters: J-series out, M-series in, closed; explosive in hole (+3 -> 64), detonator to explosive and timer, timer 30, W, NW: "You hear a loud but distant explosion." Safe blown open: key (+7 -> 71). Headlamp dimming -> off. Saved "Commander's Quarters day 3 score 71".
Cmds 1431-1495: Dome: unlocked the bin with the key; opening it, the fuel cells EXPLODED (sabotage), knocked me out, the station lights went out, and the air-shaft grating came loose. Bent it open, got in (+2 -> 73), climbed 7 x Down to the Bottom of Air Shaft (P.A.: "Prepare for launch of second-generation pyramids. Station will be eliminated by reactor overload immediately following launch."). Opening the bottom grating dropped me into Computer Control (Level 9) where the EXERCISE MACHINE charges ("No pain, no gain!") -> "(The game can no longer be won: you dropped into Computer Control without the jammer.)".
