Saves: "Dome, day 3, score 71, move 636" (jammer in hand, but the headlamp dies on the next action = effectively lost), "Dome, day 3, score 71, move 609" (no jammer, lamp low), "Commander's Quarters, day 3, score 71, move 597" (key in hand, before the Dome).**

### Map additions (this leg)
- Dome: after the bin blast the air-shaft grating opens -> Top of Air Shaft -> Air Shaft x5 -> Bottom of Air Shaft -> (grating, one-way drop) Computer Control (Level 9: exercise machine, ladder up to Level 8, elevator N).
- Flophouse bed works (take the suit OFF and the lamp OFF before sleeping).

### Puzzles solved (this leg, with the procedure)
- Chapel star (+7): lure the Arcturian balloon creature with the SPORZ can by spraying in the room NEXT to it, one room at a time (9 sprays Pet Store -> Broadway -> Makeshift -> East Connection -> East Junction -> North Junction -> Level Five -> Four -> Three -> Chapel; do not waste sprays). Turn the eternal flame off (pulpit > Open > switch > Turn off). Take the leash: it lifts you 2 m. Take the star, Down. Open the star: M-series hyperdiode.
- Safe (+3 explosive, +7 key): M-series hyperdiode in the detonator (the J-series silently fails), close it; explosive in hole; detonator > Connect to explosive, then to timer; timer 30; W, NW. Key in the safe.
- Dome bin: key unlocks it; the fuel cells explode, but this frees the air-shaft grating (+2 for entering).

### Open puzzles and theories
- Computer Control: bring the JAMMER (on, 710, twenty-prong board) when dropping in, against the exercise machine. Then stop the pyramid launch (foil = platinum = element 78, the pyramid's weakness; Floyd loves reflective things).
- Light: the headlamp runs out; turn it off whenever you can. The station goes dark after the bin blast. Fetch the jammer BEFORE opening the Dome bin.
- Getting home: the fuel cells are gone, so the ending must be something else (escape pod? alien ship?).

### Numbers and procedures from the papers
- FREZONE sheet: hole, detonator to explosive and timer, set timer, vamoose; under 150 K except ~100 millichrons. The Thermos keeps it cold; leaving it in the vac yard keeps it safe overnight.
- Gym sign: frequency 710 -> jammer setting.
- QX-17-T course slip: only needed for launching the truck (time -> course, e.g. 5167 -> 313).

### Correction (last commands)
- Restored "Commander's Quarters day 3 71" and walked toward the jammer: the station lights went out on the way (Grocery), WITHOUT opening the Dome bin. So the blackout is timed, and the lamp is the only light from then on. The cap was reached in the Grocery (lamp on).

### What I would try next
1. From the "Commander's Quarters, day 3, score 71" save (lamp OFF): walk to the Trading Post first for the jammer (check it says on/710), then the Dome; open the bin; open the grating, get in, 7 x Down, open the grating with the jammer in hand; lamp on only in the dark rooms.
2. In Computer Control: use the foil/zapgun against the pyramid; look at Level 8 by the ladder.

friction.result: Yippee! yells Floyd, bounding over
friction.why: Keypad number entry in the menu was obvious and getting Floyd felt great

friction.result: truck's air gushes out through the open hatch. You have died
friction.why: I tried to close the hatch from the seat but couldn't reach; seat sat me in before warning, and the truck still let me set a course with the hatch open. Fair in hindsight, but harsh for a newbie

friction.result: You're neither hungry nor thirsty. (You'll be able to eat once you are hungry, in about 319 moves...)
friction.why: Clear hint about when hunger returns; saves me worrying

friction.command: 695 Tell Floyd to… > Take… > medium drill bit
friction.result: Floyd reaches into the heating chamber... drops it to the deck, where it quickly cools. Then +3
friction.why: The Tell Floyd to Take submenu offered exactly the thing I couldn't reach, so I discovered the robot-helper trick by tapping

friction.command: 778 Take (mauve spool) with 8 things in hand
friction.result: the crumpled form slips from your hands... (With more than seven things in your hands, a take may fumble. Worn things don't count, and neither does anything inside a container you carry.)
friction.why: The parenthetical rule finally explained the '(a take may fumble)' label; I'd seen the warning for 50 commands without knowing containers were the fix

friction.command: 41 (put ironed validated entry form in South Connection slot)
friction.result: The hatch begins irising open, then sparks... about half dilated, wide enough to pass through. +6
friction.why: Chain of trash can -> stamp -> laundry presser -> slot felt clever and every step was offered in the menus

friction.result: New rank is 9: HyperAdmiral.
friction.why: Number-entry keypad entry made this obvious once the voice asked for a rank; fun payoff for the log's Shady Dan clue

friction.command: Barbershop: examine mirror / look behind mirror / examine floor / wall menu
friction.result: The detector is quietly beeping. ... The mirror seems to be affixed to the wall.
friction.why: The detector says platinum is here but no menu shows anything to search or take; I could not find what it was beeping at

friction.command: 10039 Take (magnetic boots, ID card in uniform)
friction.result: your ID card twitches toward their magnetic soles: carried together with them, it would be wiped. (There will be no second warning...)
friction.why: A fair one-time warning saved my freshly upgraded HyperAdmiral card; exactly the kind of guardrail a newbie needs

friction.result: Lists the taste-words of the alien message
friction.why: Taste was right on the dots menu, and the output lines up neatly with the Mayor's glossary - satisfying decode

friction.result: Plato stuns me and tells the pyramid backstory; Floyd saves me (+7)
friction.why: Great dramatic twist, and the Tell Floyd submenu offered sensible things to try while paralysed; waiting resolved it

friction.result: Air whooshes out, lungs rupture, death
friction.why: No warning that I'd need a suit; the only stencil talks about open containers, so a newbie reads it as 'close your bags and go'. Instant death without any hint felt harsh (I had saved)

friction.command: Tell Floyd to Reach into the dispenser (PX)
friction.result: Not even a ball. (Someone with a longer reach might have better luck.)
friction.why: The Tell-Floyd menu offered the exact action, and the parenthetical hint pointed me at the ostrich - fair nudge

friction.result: The coffee is poisoned! ... You have died
friction.why: I was hungry/thirsty with no food left, and the only drink offered on screen killed me instantly with no warning sign beyond 'thick brown'. As a newbie I can't tell deadly props from food

friction.result: You'll have to open the counter first.
friction.why: The counter's menu (and More...) has no Open entry, so in click mode I can't do what the game tells me to; in leg 1 searching it worked

friction.result: Collapse from extreme thirst and hunger; no food source found anywhere
friction.why: Four rations ran out by day 3 and nothing else edible exists that I can find; one lost cup (nectar) seems to have doomed the whole run 400 commands later. A newbie gets no warning that food is finite and critical until it's too late

friction.result: Reply printed a 'Junk Yard' heading with the sculpture joke text, then '## Studio'
friction.why: The stray 'Junk Yard' title made me think I had gone to the wrong room for a moment; looks like the first-visit text is labelled with the wrong room name

friction.command: wait (x4, stunned by Plato at Level Five)
friction.result: Floyd bursts into tears, dashes out; Plato shoots; died
friction.why: In my first run just waiting worked (I had also told Floyd things); this time waiting alone killed me. The game says 'you can still speak' but no menu offers anything to say; I only know Tell Floyd from the first run

friction.command: Tell Floyd to > Take > The stun ray (during Plato's speech)
friction.result: Floyd knocks the gun away, Plato is blown apart, +7
friction.why: Once I opened Floyd's menu, 'Save you', 'Turn off Plato' and 'Help!' were offered right there; pleading three times made Floyd act. Dramatic and satisfying

friction.command: Papers > Blueprint 8 and 9 of 9 (read in the spacetruck)
friction.result: Level 7/8 plans show a utility shaft and air duct beside the elevator, and access hatches on Level 8
friction.why: The package blueprints gave me a concrete lead on the sealed Level 8 (the Dome's air shaft grating) when I was stuck; good use of the feelies

friction.command: east (Alley -> Junk Yard, first visit this run)
friction.result: Printed a 'Studio' heading with the junk-pile joke text, then '## Junk Yard'
friction.why: Same as the Studio visit but mirrored: the first-visit joke paragraphs of Studio and Junk Yard appear to carry each other's room names as headings

friction.result: You'll have to open the counter first.
friction.why: The counter menu (and its More... submenu) has no Open entry, so the game asks for something the menus never offer; the first search found the nectar without opening anything

friction.result: Exits appear above and to the north, +4
friction.why: Tapping the shiny game object paid off with a secret passage; exactly the kind of surprise a tap-everything player loves

friction.command: Sleep (weary, in the Commander's bed, explosive in the closed Thermos)
friction.result: Woke day 3; 'The game can no longer be won: the explosive was gone when you woke'
friction.why: The game told me to sleep at once (weary) while the Frezone was in a closed Thermos; nothing warned that sleeping would lose it. Restored. The unwinnable notice itself was clear and helpful

friction.command: Bomb the safe: explosive in hole, detonator (closed, J-series hyperdiode inside) connected to explosive and timer, timer set 30/50, step out
friction.result: Timer reaches 0 with no sound or message; afterwards the detonator is empty (the hyperdiode has vanished) and the explosive later sublimes; game unwinnable
friction.why: Tried twice with every connection confirmed; nothing tells me why it failed or that the hyperdiode was used up. If the J-series is the wrong diode, some message (a fizzle, a pop) is needed; silent vanishing looks like a bug

friction.command: Sleep (Flophouse bed) with the headlamp still on
friction.result: Woke day 3: 'The game can no longer be won: the headlamp is dead, with the explosive left in the dark.'
friction.why: I never saw a battery warning for the headlamp, so a lamp left on during sleep killing the game was a surprise; the unwinnable notice at least told me at once (helpful)

friction.command: Take leash (Pet Store, after spraying spores)
friction.result: Creature farts, I drop everything; '(It will do this every time here. Perhaps it would behave differently somewhere with gravity.)'
friction.why: A clear nudge after many failed tries: tells me to stop repeating and think about gravity

friction.command: Spray can in the room next to the balloon creature (Broadway)
friction.result: The Arcturian balloon creature farts in, hungrily gobbling up the spores.
friction.why: Satisfying aha: spraying in the next room lures it along, room by room

friction.command: Spray can (luring the balloon creature, Level Three, one room from the Chapel)
friction.result: '(The game can no longer be won: the spray can is empty.)'
friction.why: The can never says how many sprays are left (no 'nearly empty' or hissing warning), so I wasted sprays experimenting in the Pet Store and ran out one room short. A low-can warning would be fair

friction.command: Bomb the safe with the chapel star's M-series hyperdiode in the detonator
friction.result: 'You hear a loud but distant explosion.'
friction.why: After two silent fizzles with the J-series, the star's diode works: big payoff, though the J-series failure needed a message to point this way

friction.command: Open the grating at the bottom of the air shaft
friction.result: Spills me into Computer Control with the exercise machine charging; '(The game can no longer be won: you dropped into Computer Control without the jammer.)'
friction.why: The drop is one-way and gives no warning before. The notice is clear and names the missing item (the jammer, freq 710 per the gym sign), which tells me exactly what to fetch

friction.command: Open the Dome air-shaft grating (second trip, carrying the jammer)
friction.result: 'The light from the headlamp flickers and dies! It is now too dark to see.' The grating vanishes from the menus in the dark; the P.A. counts down 'Launch in 200 millichrons'
friction.why: The station lights go out for good after the fuel-cell blast, and the only lamp ran out mid-endgame. The 'somewhat dimmer' warnings came, but there was no spare light anywhere and no way to know how many turns it had left. The jammer-less drop cost the trip that drained it
